answer: Vouch-chain liability: a fresh identity may enter consensus only after an established sponsor stakes 2,000 POA behind its first forty epochs, and each sponsor may vouch for at most three newcomers. When two identities under one sponsor echo a forged fable of activity, identical attestations replayed across shards, the pigment of trust peels off: 30% of the sponsor stake burns per fraudulent account and the newcomers' deposits lock. Cost per fake identity: 2,000 POA fronted plus a 600 POA sponsor penalty, scaling linearly, while honest operators keep their willow-branch collateral untouched.
